summary: Align Technology filed an 8-K disclosing an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC dated November 5, 2026, to buy back $270 million of common stock under its $1.0 billion April 2025 repurchase program, which had $600 million remaining. The company prepaid $270 million and received an initial delivery of roughly 1.44 million shares; final share count settles off average daily VWAP less a discount, expected by approximately December 29, 2026. Watch settlement true-up share/cash delivery and program capacity.
